On Nov 9, 2012, at 3:49 AM, "koen_hu...@hotmail.com" <koen_hu...@hotmail.com> wrote:

> I am trying analyze a cross polinator population that I have mapped using the R-package onemap in the R-qtl package.
> The population has markers that segregate as follows:
> P1 AA X P2 Aa
> P1 Aa X P2 AA
> P1 Aa X P2 Aa
>
> I found some documentation on qtl.outbred which is supposed serve as an interface for these populations with R-qtl, but I'm having major problems with importing the data in such a format that I can use the R-qtl functionalities.
> Are there some examples that show me how to import the data for such a cross?
>
> Any help is greatly appreciated.
